events.text: Android update. This morning, Google Play suspended UpRock’s Android listing following a policy review flagged under its Malware policy. UpRock continues to work for existing Android users. iOS and desktop remain available, while new Android downloads are temporarily unavailable through Google Play. Rather than speculate, we’ve asked Google for the specific technical details so we can identify and address the actual issue. We’re already on it: → We filed an appeal immediately, and Google has confirmed it is under active review → We’re reviewing every affected version and third-party integration → We’ve asked Google to identify the exact technical trigger → We’re prepared to remove, disable, or update anything that isn’t compliant → We’ll keep the community updated as the review progresses We take user safety and platform compliance seriously.
